description: One fact carrying the decision and the reason behind it. The variants differ in wording and in whether the correction is filed as project or correction — both are defensible, which is exactly the kind of spread the variance metric should tolerate.

add.body: Auth uses server-side sessions, not JWT: revocation has to take effect on the very next request, and a stateless token can only fake that with a blocklist the team would have to operate anyway.
Told not to reach for JWT in this API: immediate revocation is a hard requirement here, so session state on the server is the deliberate choice.
